roam.passport.localOnly.en: Based on up to 50 saved walks on this device, not your account’s lifetime totals. Open your records below to review them.

roam.passport.counting.zh-Hans: 探店次数按每次漫游累加，不代表去重店铺数。活跃日按已存时间戳与本机时区归并。
